vocabulary_groups.title: Feedback core nouns and verbs
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for talking about comments, revision, and improvement in a design class.

items.definition_en: Comments that help improve work.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Comments that help make the design better.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Comentarios que ajudam a melhorar o design.
items.example_sentence_en: The student gives simple feedback on the sketch.
items.example_sentence_pt: The student gives simple feedback on the sketch.
items.professional_context_en: Feedback is the main Week 13 concept for studio critique and revision.
items.professional_context_pt: Feedback e o conceito principal da Semana 13 para critica de estudio e revisao.
items.translation_notes_pt: The borrowed word feedback is common, but students still need the full English classroom use.

items.definition_en: A short opinion or response about the work.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A short thing you say about the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma coisa curta que voce diz sobre o design.
items.example_sentence_en: My first comment is positive.
items.example_sentence_pt: My first comment is positive.
items.professional_context_en: Comment supports simple critique and response language.
items.professional_context_pt: Comment apoia a linguagem simples de critica e resposta.

items.definition_en: An idea for making the work better.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A polite idea for change.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma ideia educada para mudar algo.
items.example_sentence_en: My suggestion is to add more contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: My suggestion is to add more contrast.
items.professional_context_en: Suggestion is key for polite critique before revision.
items.professional_context_pt: Suggestion e importante para a critica educada antes da revisao.
items.translation_notes_pt: Teach as polite advice, not as an order.

items.definition_en: A change made after feedback.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A change you make after comments.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma mudanca que voce faz depois dos comentarios.
items.example_sentence_en: The revision makes the caption clearer.
items.example_sentence_pt: The revision makes the caption clearer.
items.professional_context_en: Revision connects critique language to the next design step.
items.professional_context_pt: Revision conecta a linguagem de critica ao proximo passo do design.
items.translation_notes_pt: Revision here means change after feedback, not only checking again.

items.definition_en: A strong positive feature of the work.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The best good part of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A melhor parte positiva do design.
items.example_sentence_en: The main strength is the silhouette.
items.example_sentence_pt: The main strength is the silhouette.
items.professional_context_en: Strength helps students move beyond very general praise.
items.professional_context_pt: Strength ajuda os alunos a irem alem de elogios muito gerais.

vocabulary_groups.title: Positive comment and reason frames
vocabulary_groups.description: High-frequency feedback phrases for saying what works and why.

items.definition_en: A simple way to start a positive comment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A simple beginning for saying something good.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um comeco simples para dizer algo bom.
items.example_sentence_en: I like the color palette.
items.example_sentence_pt: I like the color palette.
items.professional_context_en: I like ... is a safe A2 frame for beginner critique.
items.professional_context_pt: I like ... e uma estrutura segura de nivel A2 para critica inicial.

items.definition_en: Is successful or looks effective.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Looks good and makes sense in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Fica bom e faz sentido no design.
items.example_sentence_en: The fabric works well with the long dress.
items.example_sentence_pt: The fabric works well with the long dress.
items.professional_context_en: Works well is useful for palette, silhouette, fabric, and detail comments.
items.professional_context_pt: Works well e util para comentarios sobre paleta, silhueta, tecido e detalhe.

items.definition_en: The best or most successful part of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The part that works best.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte que funciona melhor.
items.example_sentence_en: The strongest part is the jacket shape.
items.example_sentence_pt: The strongest part is the jacket shape.
items.professional_context_en: This frame helps students name one specific strength in critique.
items.professional_context_pt: Essa estrutura ajuda os alunos a nomear um ponto forte especifico na critica.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to a parte mais forte.

items.definition_en: A word used to give a reason.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A word for saying why.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma palavra para dizer por que.
items.example_sentence_en: I like the look because it is balanced.
items.example_sentence_pt: I like the look because it is balanced.
items.professional_context_en: Because is the key Week 13 connector for useful feedback.
items.professional_context_pt: Because e o principal conector da Semana 13 para um feedback util.

items.definition_en: A phrase used to explain a design effect.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A way to say what effect the design makes.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma forma de dizer qual efeito o design cria.
items.example_sentence_en: This creates a calm mood.
items.example_sentence_pt: This creates a calm mood.
items.professional_context_en: This creates helps students explain visual effect without long writing.
items.professional_context_pt: This creates ajuda os alunos a explicar efeito visual sem escrita longa.

vocabulary_groups.title: Suggestion and polite critique
vocabulary_groups.description: Frames and verbs for making one respectful improvement idea.

items.definition_en: A polite way to give a suggestion.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A polite way to say one idea for change.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma forma educada de dizer uma ideia de mudanca.
items.example_sentence_en: You could add more contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: You could add more contrast.
items.professional_context_en: You could is the main suggestion frame for Week 13.
items.professional_context_pt: You could e a principal estrutura de sugestao da Semana 13.
items.pronunciation_notes: Stress COULD in short polite speech.

items.definition_en: A softer and more careful suggestion frame.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A softer way to give advice.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma forma mais suave de dar um conselho.
items.example_sentence_en: Maybe you could simplify the caption.
items.example_sentence_pt: Maybe you could simplify the caption.
items.professional_context_en: Maybe you could helps students sound respectful in critique.
items.professional_context_pt: Maybe you could ajuda os alunos a soar respeitosos na critica.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to talvez voce pudesse or talvez voce poderia.

items.definition_en: To put something new into the design or text.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To put one more thing in.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Colocar mais uma coisa.
items.example_sentence_en: Add one small detail near the neckline.
items.example_sentence_pt: Add one small detail near the neckline.
items.professional_context_en: Add supports practical critique of detail, contrast, and information.
items.professional_context_pt: Add apoia a critica pratica de detalhe, contraste e informacao.

items.definition_en: To make something different.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To make it different from now.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Fazer algo ficar diferente do que esta agora.
items.example_sentence_en: Change the color balance a little.
items.example_sentence_pt: Change the color balance a little.
items.professional_context_en: Change helps students suggest revision without sounding too complex.
items.professional_context_pt: Change ajuda os alunos a sugerir revisao sem soar complexo demais.

items.definition_en: To make an idea easier to understand.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To make the idea more clear.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Deixar a ideia mais clara.
items.example_sentence_en: Clarify the caption with one more sentence.
items.example_sentence_pt: Clarify the caption with one more sentence.
items.professional_context_en: Clarify is useful for caption and mini board revision before Week 14.
items.professional_context_pt: Clarify e util para revisar caption e mini board antes da Semana 14.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to esclarecer or deixar mais claro.

vocabulary_groups.title: Design focus and evaluation words
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for naming the critique focus and the overall design effect.

items.definition_en: The set of colors used in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The colors in the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: As cores do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is soft and calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is soft and calm.
items.professional_context_en: Color palette is a common focus area for beginner design critique.
items.professional_context_pt: Color palette e uma area de foco comum para a critica inicial de design.

items.definition_en: The outer shape or outline of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The main outside shape of the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A forma principal externa do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette looks strong and modern.
items.example_sentence_pt: The silhouette looks strong and modern.
items.professional_context_en: Silhouette helps students critique shape in a fashion-specific way.
items.professional_context_pt: Silhouette ajuda os alunos a criticar a forma de um jeito especifico de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: Keep pronunciation support visible because the spelling is not transparent.

items.definition_en: A strong visible difference between colors, shapes, or details.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A clear difference you can see.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma diferenca clara que voce consegue ver.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket needs more contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket needs more contrast.
items.professional_context_en: Contrast gives students a useful critique word for color and structure.
items.professional_context_pt: Contrast oferece aos alunos uma palavra de critica util para cor e estrutura.
items.translation_notes_pt: Keep pronunciation support visible because the spelling is not transparent.

items.definition_en: Well organized and not too heavy in one area.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Looking even and well organized.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Com aparencia equilibrada e bem organizada.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look feels balanced.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look feels balanced.
items.professional_context_en: Balanced helps students give more useful feedback than only nice or good.
items.professional_context_pt: Balanced ajuda os alunos a dar um feedback mais util do que apenas nice ou good.

items.definition_en: Easy to understand or easy to see.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Not confusing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Nao confuso.
items.example_sentence_en: The main idea is clear.
items.example_sentence_pt: The main idea is clear.
items.professional_context_en: Clear supports feedback on both design images and short captions.
items.professional_context_pt: Clear apoia o feedback tanto sobre imagens de design quanto sobre captions curtos.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to claro, but keep the English output in activities.
